name: 订阅额度
description: 在工作面板中可视化订阅账号的剩余额度：Anthropic (Claude Pro/Max)、OpenAI (ChatGPT Plus/Pro)、GitHub Copilot、OpenRouter 等，按 5 小时 / 每周 / 每月 / 余额窗口显示剩余百分比、重置倒计时与进度条（绿=剩余、灰=已用）。只显示本机已登录的账号。
author: czp0312
changelog: Release 0.2.0：支持八家订阅服务商（Anthropic / OpenAI / GitHub Copilot / OpenRouter 内置适配器，Kimi Code / Meta / Radius / xAI 走自定义来源），只显示本机已登录的账号；进度条改为绿色填充 = 剩余额度、灰色底槽 = 已用额度；修正 OpenAI 额度字段解析与重置倒计时。
safetyNotes: 只显示插件真正拿到凭据的账号。凭据来源两类：① 你在本插件私有设置里填写的令牌；② 本机已登录的 CLI / 编辑器留下的凭据文件（~/.claude/.credentials.json、~/.codex/auth.json、github-copilot 的 hosts.json / apps.json），由插件进程内的 Node fs 读取。插件刻意不读取 PI-Desktop 自己的加密密钥库。令牌不写日志、不进缓存、不返回给界面；返回的只有额度数字。联网仅限 net.domains 里声明的八个服务商域名。

en.name: Subscription Quotas
en.description: Visualize the remaining quota of your subscription accounts in the work panel — Anthropic (Claude Pro/Max), OpenAI (ChatGPT Plus/Pro), GitHub Copilot, OpenRouter and more — as 5-hour / weekly / monthly / credit windows with remaining percentage, reset countdown and a progress bar (green = remaining, grey = used). Only accounts signed in on this machine are shown.
en.safetyNotes: Only accounts the plugin can actually obtain a credential for are shown; everything else stays hidden. Two credential sources only: (1) a token you type into this plugin's own private settings, and (2) credential files an already-signed-in CLI/editor left on this machine, read with Node fs inside the plugin process — ~/.claude/.credentials.json (Claude Code), ~/.codex/auth.json (Codex CLI) and github-copilot hosts.json/apps.json. The plugin deliberately does NOT read PI-Desktop's own encrypted secret store, the AES-256-GCM secrets folder under the app data directory — its OAuth credentials are isolated from plugins on purpose, so an account signed in only through PI-Desktop's Settings shows nothing here until you also supply a token. Tokens are never logged, never cached and never returned to the view; only quota figures are. Network access is limited to the eight vendor hosts declared in net.domains.

zh-CN.name: 订阅额度
zh-CN.description: 在工作面板中可视化订阅账号的剩余额度：Anthropic (Claude Pro/Max)、OpenAI (ChatGPT Plus/Pro)、GitHub Copilot、OpenRouter 等，按 5 小时 / 每周 / 每月 / 余额窗口显示剩余百分比、重置倒计时与进度条（绿=剩余、灰=已用）。只显示本机已登录的账号。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 只显示插件真正拿到凭据的账号，其余一律不显示。凭据只有两个来源：① 你在本插件私有设置里填写的令牌；② 本机已登录的 CLI / 编辑器留下的凭据文件，由插件进程内的 Node fs 读取——~/.claude/.credentials.json（Claude Code）、~/.codex/auth.json（Codex CLI）、github-copilot 的 hosts.json / apps.json。插件刻意不读取 PI-Desktop 自己的加密密钥库（应用数据目录下那个 AES-256-GCM 的 secrets 文件夹）：它的 OAuth 凭据是被有意隔离在插件之外的，所以只在 PI-Desktop 设置里登录过的账号，在没有另填令牌之前不会显示任何内容。令牌不写日志、不进缓存、不返回给界面；返回的只有额度数字。联网仅限 net.domains 里声明的八个服务商域名。

settings.title: 自动发现本机已登录的账号
settings.description: 读取 Claude Code / Codex / Copilot 留下的凭据文件；找不到的账号不会显示。

settings.title: 演示数据（不访问网络）
settings.description: 只渲染内置示例账号，便于预览界面。

settings.title: 自动刷新间隔（秒）
settings.description: 面板打开时轮询新数据的间隔，最小 30 秒。

settings.title: 手工令牌（JSON 对象）
settings.description: 厂商 id → 令牌。例如 {"openrouter":"sk-or-...","anthropic":"...","openai-codex":"...","github-copilot":"...","kimi-coding":"...","meta":"...","radius":"...","xai":"..."}。填了才算已登录。

settings.title: 自定义额度来源（JSON 数组）
settings.description: 给没有内置适配器的厂商配置接口：{ vendor, label, url, token?, headers?, windows?: [{ path, period?, usedField?, resetField?, minutesField?, label? }] }。不写 windows 时按常见字段名自动识别。

settings.title: 手动额度（JSON 数组，不联网）
settings.description: 直接手填窗口：{ id, label, plan?, windows: [{ period, label?, used?, limit?, unit?, usedPercent?, resetsAt? }] }。period 取 session / day / week / month / credit。
